data.title: 空弦 · 烛台前的晚祷与啤酒配方沉思
data.action: 单膝跪在祷告木凳前双手合十，羽耳在烛光下微微泛光，祈祷完毕后起身，视线偷偷瞟向桌上写着修道院特产啤酒改良配方的羊皮纸
data.location: 罗德岛宗教区兼兰赛尔办事处静室
data.lighting: 两支粗黄铜烛台点燃的明暖烛光，照亮圣洁蓝白睡袍与修道院木雕十字架
data.mood: 虔诚神圣与精明修道院商业头脑的奇妙反差萌
data.description: 罗德岛静谧的祷告室。空弦换上一袭兰赛尔修道院天青圣洁亚麻长款睡袍，羽翼般纤秀的鸟耳在烛火下轻轻摇曳。她刚刚完成每日例行的祈祷，手掌尚未松开，蓝灰色的瞳眸却忍不住偷偷溜向旁边摆着的“兰赛尔特酿麦芽啤酒改良方案”。她察觉到门口的视线，立刻正襟危坐，脸颊微红——「咳！博士……修道院的复兴也是神圣事业的一部分！这、这绝对不是在祈祷时分心哦！」
data.promptProse: Archetto finishes evening devotions inside a serene monastery-style chamber aboard Rhodes Island, wearing a sky-blue and bleached-white organic linen night robe with wide sleeves and a gold-stitched rope belt. Kneeling at a wooden prayer bench with clasped hands, she betrays her pious posture with a faint blush and a cheeky sideways glance toward brewing parchments lit by two brass candlesticks.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling beside a wooden prayer bench in her sky-blue and white linen monastic night robe, she keeps her hands clasped while sneaking a sheepish blush and sideways glance toward brewery parchments on the desk. Two brass candlesticks bathe the quiet chamber in warm flickering light.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sky-blue and bleached-white monastic linen night robe with wide flowing sleeves, a loose hood, and a gold-stitched rope belt with a small cross clasp.
